Io, the Herbal Witch

New: her book, her dagger and her sickle. She carries the book in her left arm; try "Read her book" and "Hold her sickle" under Moves, and watch the book float beside her when she needs both hands. She stays in view while you scroll the buttons. Drag to turn her, pinch or scroll to zoom.

New in this stage

  • Her book (G1, G2): dark leather with gold corners and the gold star on its cover. She carries it shut in her left arm, as in G8.
  • "Read her book": she holds it open in front of her, looks down, follows the lines with a finger and turns a leaf now and then.
  • When a move needs her left hand or both hands (talk, tip her hat, curtsey, twirl, pick a herb), she lets go and the book floats open at her left side, as your rules for her say.
  • Her dagger (G6): in its black sheath with gold ends, at her left hip, with the crescent guard. It swings on her belt.
  • Her sickle (G5): "Hold her sickle" lifts it in her right hand: a golden crescent blade on a dark grip.
  • "Book and blades" under Show takes them off. Held still, for checking against the paintings, she carries nothing.

From the earlier stages

  • Her ankles, her wrists and her coy wave (stage six). Her belt, pouch, crystal, necklaces and bracelets (stage five). Her cloak with the moss, and her painted hands (stage four). Her arms, her moving hair and skirt, and her first moves (stage three). Her face, glasses, hair and hat (stage two). Her body, bodice and skirt (stage one).

What is rough, and what is not here yet

  • The cloak is a first build. Its cloth and trim are drawn by code in F6's colours, not cut from your swatches yet. It is not see-through.
  • Its body is fuller and rounder than in your picture, because it rides on the skirt. Its sleeves are narrower than the wide wings in your picture.
  • Hair and sleeves can pass through each other at her shoulders. A forearm can show through a sleeve when her elbow bends.
  • I tuned the moves from still pictures and cannot watch them play.
  • The thin edge of each hand (thumb side, little-finger side) is soft paint with no detail: the paintings do not show it.
  • The new pieces are plain shapes: the belt has no gold vine or holes yet, the pouch has no flap, studs or filigree, and the necklace pendant does not swing.
  • Book and blades are a first build: her fingers do not wrap the book or the sickle exactly, the dagger cannot be drawn yet, and the sickle simply appears in her hand.
  • Not here yet: squat, kneel, hover and jog; the faces in C10; her spells and attacks.
